name: Referred Document Type 1
definition: Specifies the type of the document referred in the remittance information.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Document type in a coded form.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Proprietary identification of the type of the remittance document.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Identification of the issuer of the reference document type.

CodeOrProprietaryRule.definition: If Code is present then Proprietary must not be present.|If Proprietary is present then Code must not be present.
